Invoice po_number may be '-'. Resent invoices share invoice_number with resent=true.

files.test_impl.py:
import pytest
from impl import run

BANK = 'Datum;Částka;Měna;Protistrana;VS;Zpráva;Zůstatek\n01.09.2026;-1 210,00;CZK;X;11;f;1\n02.09.2026;-1 210,00;CZK;X;11;f;1\n03.09.2026;-500,00;CZK;X;22;f;1\n'
PO = 'po_number,supplier,order_date,sku,description,qty,unit_price_czk\nPO-1,X,2026-08-01,A,Thing,10,100.00\nPO-2,X,2026-08-01,B,Other,5,50.00\n'

def setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    d = tmp_path / 'inbox' / 'f'; d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / 'bank_statement.csv').write_text(BANK, encoding='utf-8')
    (d / 'purchase_orders.csv').write_text(PO, encoding='utf-8')
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)

def inv(n, vs, po, code, qty, up, total, file=None, resent=False):
    return {'file': file or n + '.txt', 'supplier': 'X', 'invoice_number': n, 'vs': vs, 'po_number': po,
            'items': [{'code': code, 'qty': qty, 'unit_price': up, 'amount': qty * up}], 'total': total, 'resent': resent}

def test_findings(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    r = run({'folder': 'f', 'invoices': [inv('I1', '11', 'PO-1', 'A', 10, 100.0, 1210.0), inv('I2', '22', 'PO-2', 'B', 8, 50.0, 484.0), inv('I3', '33', '-', 'A', 1, 100.0, 121.0)]})
    t = {f['type'] for f in r['findings']}
    assert {'double_payment', 'quantity_mismatch', 'no_order', 'payment_mismatch'} <= t
    dp = [f for f in r['findings'] if f['type'] == 'double_payment'][0]
    assert len(dp['bank_rows']) == 2 and dp['expected'] == 1210.0 and dp['actual'] == 2420.0
    q = [f for f in r['findings'] if f['type'] == 'quantity_mismatch'][0]
    assert q['po_lines'][0]['line'] == 1 and q['expected'] == 5 and q['actual'] == 8

def test_price_and_duplicate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    a = inv('I1', '11', 'PO-1', 'A', 10, 110.0, 1331.0)
    b = inv('I1', '11', 'PO-1', 'A', 10, 110.0, 1331.0, file='I1_R.txt', resent=True)
    r = run({'folder': 'f', 'invoices': [a, b], 'checks': ['duplicate', 'price_mismatch']})
    t = sorted(f['type'] for f in r['findings'])
    assert t == ['duplicate', 'price_mismatch']
    p = [f for f in r['findings'] if f['type'] == 'price_mismatch'][0]
    assert p['difference_czk'] == 100.0

def test_supplier_filter(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    r = run({'folder': 'f', 'invoices': [inv('I3', '33', '-', 'A', 1, 100.0, 121.0)], 'supplier_filter': 'zzz'})
    assert r['findings'] == []

def test_bad_input(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': 'nope', 'invoices': []})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': 'f', 'invoices': 'x'})
